label: More autonomy, more accountability
claim: The more autonomy an agent has, the more identity, permissions, data boundaries, approvals, monitoring, traceability and human accountability matter.

label: An agent is what it can reach
claim: An agent's real role is not the job title written in its prompt, but the commands, files, shell, package managers, services and data it can actually reach.

label: Short loops, a person in the loop
claim: Rather than handing an agent a task overnight, I prefer small task blocks, frequent review and continuous correction, so a person keeps hold of the context and the quality.

label: Human judgement sets the value
claim: AI should extend professional knowledge, not replace creative judgement: human taste, brand, mechanics and distinctive input decide what the output is worth.

label: AI needs people who bridge
claim: Putting AI to work needs hybrid roles that understand the business, dig out the real need, shape the specification and work alongside the people building it.

label: A model is not a workflow
claim: The gap that matters is between a model that can answer a question and a workflow that can safely use real data, permissions and human review.
